purpose: Form INC-27 is used for various company conversions under the Companies Act, 2013, such as converting a public company into a private company, an unlimited liability company into a limited liability company, or a company limited by guarantee into a company limited by shares.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Pass a special resolution in a general meeting for the proposed company conversion.
File the required application and documents with the Regional Director or Registrar of Companies as specified in the rules.
Include required particulars, e-Memorandum of Association, e-Articles of Association, and necessary declarations.
Pay the required fee as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014.
checklist: Copy of the special resolution passed in the general meeting
Altered e-Memorandum of Association and e-Articles of Association
Minutes of the general meeting with voting details
Board resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing the filing
Declarations by key managerial personnel or directors regarding compliance
attachments: e-Memorandum of Association and e-Articles of Association with proposed alterations
Copy of the minutes of the general meeting
Copy of Board resolution or Power of Attorney
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director
Notice of the general meeting along with explanatory statement
watch: Ensure filings are made within the specific time limits prescribed for each type of conversion.
